text_en: Some time afterward, David attacked the Philistines and subdued them; he took Gath and its villages from the Philistines.
text_cn: 此后，达味攻打培肋舍特人，将他们克服，由培肋舍特人手中，夺取了加特城及所属村镇。

text_en: He defeated Moab, and the Moabites became subject to David and brought tribute.
text_cn: 以后打败了摩阿布，摩阿布人也臣属于达味，给他进贡。

text_en: David also struck down King Hadadezer of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to set up a monument at the river Euphrates.
text_cn: 当祚巴哈玛特王哈达德则尔向幼发拉的河伸展自己的势力时，达味也打败了他，

text_en: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand cavalry, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left one hundred of them.
text_cn: 掳获了他的车辆一千，骑兵七千，步兵两万；达味割断了所有拉战车的马蹄筋，只留下足以拉一百辆车的马。

text_en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand Arameans.
text_cn: 后有大马士革的阿兰人，来援助祚巴王哈达德则尔，达味击杀了两万二千阿兰人。

text_en: Then David put garrisons in Aram of Damascus; and the Arameans became subject to David, and brought tribute. The Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
text_cn: 达味遂在大马士革阿兰屯兵驻守，阿兰也臣属于达味，给他进贡；达味无论往哪里去，上主总使他获胜。

text_en: David took the gold shields that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 达味夺了哈达德则尔臣仆所带的金盾牌，送到耶路撒冷。

text_en: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a vast quantity of bronze; with it Solomon made the bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze.
text_cn: 达味又由贝塔和贡，哈达德则尔的两座城内，夺取了大量的铜；以后撒罗满用来作铜海、圆柱及铜器。

text_en: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the whole army of King Hadadezer of Zobah,
text_cn: 哈玛特王托乌，听说达味打败了祚巴王哈达德则尔所有的军队，

text_en: he sent his son Hadoram to King David, to greet him and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him. Now Hadadezer had often been at war with Tou. He sent all sorts of articles of gold, of silver, and of bronze;
text_cn: 便派自己的儿子哈多兰到达味王那里，向他致敬，祝贺他打败了哈达德则尔，因哈达德则尔原是托乌的敌人；他还送来了各种金、银、铜器。

text_en: these also King David dedicated to the Lord , together with the silver and gold that he had carried off from all the nations, from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek.
text_cn: 达味王也将这些，连同那些由各民族，即厄东、摩阿布、阿孟子民、培肋舍特人、阿玛肋克人所得来的金银，一起奉献给上主。

text_en: Abishai son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
text_cn: 责鲁雅的儿子阿彼瑟在盐谷击杀了一万八千厄东人后，

text_en: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became subject to David. And the Lord gave victory to David wherever he went.
text_cn: 达味遂又屯兵厄东，厄东人全臣属于达味。达味无论往哪里去，上主总使他获胜。

text_en: So David reigned over all Israel; and he administered justice and equity to all his people.
text_cn: 达味作了全以色列的君王，对自己所有的人民秉公行义。

text_en: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;
text_cn: 责鲁雅的儿子约阿布统领军队，阿希路得的儿子约沙法特为御史，

text_en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;
text_cn: 阿希托布的儿子匝多克和厄贝雅塔尔的儿子阿希默肋客任司祭，沙委沙为秘书，

text_en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were the chief officials in the service of the king.
text_cn: 约雅达的儿子贝纳雅管理革勒提与培肋提人，达味的儿子们在君王左右为辅相。
